segments.segment_summary: Aerial footage shows a red potato harvester and a blue tractor working in a field. The harvester digs up potatoes and transfers them via a conveyor belt into large wooden crates on a trailer pulled by the tractor.

key_moments.caption: A conveyor belt on a red harvester drops freshly harvested potatoes into large wooden crates.
The camera pulls back to reveal a blue tractor pulling the trailer of crates alongside the harvester.
A wider aerial shot shows the two vehicles moving in tandem across the plowed field.
From a high angle, the harvester continues its work as the tractor and full trailer drive away.

segments.segment_summary: A man in a safety vest stands in the field next to the red potato harvester and introduces the video. He explains that they are harvesting a specific type of salad potato called 'Venezia'.

key_moments.caption: A man in a bright yellow safety vest begins speaking to the camera, standing in front of the red harvester.
He explains that he is at a neighboring farm to film the potato harvest.
He identifies the crop as a 'Venezia' salad potato and describes it as high-yielding with good flavor.

segments.segment_summary: The man describes the functionality of the Grimme Varitron 220 potato harvester. He points out the front flail mowing system and then explains how discs and conveyor webs lift the potatoes from the soil and transport them through the machine.

key_moments.caption: A low-angle shot shows the front attachment and wheel of the Grimme Varitron 220 harvester.
A hand gestures toward the front of the machine, explaining the flail mowing system for removing potato tops.
The man's hand points to different parts of the lower machine, explaining how discs lift potatoes onto webs that carry them to the back.
